changelog:
Initial release of the financial-private-equity skill.

- Provides private equity deal sourcing and workflow tools, including company discovery, CRM integration, and founder outreach.
- Includes commands for AI opportunity scanning, due diligence checklists, meeting prep, IC memo drafting, portfolio review, returns analysis, deal screening, sourcing, unit economics analysis, and value creation planning.
- Integrates with user materials via folder/file inputs or interactive prompts.
- Leverages underlying skills from the Anthropic financial-services repository for sector-specific workflows.
summary: Tools for private equity deal sourcing, CRM integration, founder outreach, due diligence, portfolio review, returns modeling, and value creation planning.
